title: feat(verify): the unique-scope derived proof family, runnable as os verify --unique-scopes (#15953 slice 3)
body:
Part of #15953
Clause-②: yes

## What this is

Slice 3 of #15953: the D halves of the classification table's rows 6-7 (comment 6115219467). It adds the unique-scope derived proof family to `@objectstack/verify`, runs it from `os verify --unique-scopes` (opt-in), and documents it. Rows 6-7's K residues stay in hotcrm, and their R residues (driver-sql DDL, ADR-0120 D3) are not in this PR. #15953 stays open for its remaining rows.

**Property, for any app.** Every field declared `unique` collides as its declared scope says (`UniqueScopeSchema`, ADR-0120 D1 and D3):

- **Within one organization**, a second holder of the value is refused, whatever the scope. On a `single`-posture boot that organization is the install's only one: the untenanted install, with no wall, where every write lands.
- **Across two organizations**, a `true` / `'organization'` value is admitted. A `'global'` value, or any value of an object with no organization column (`tenancy.enabled: false`, which degrades the scope to the column alone), is refused.

## The family (`packages/verify/src/unique-scope.ts`)

- **Population.** Every field of every declared object whose `unique`, after the spec's own `FieldSchema.safeParse`, is declared (`isUniqueDeclared`). This is the value a built artifact carries, so an `autonumber` that authors no `unique` states `'organization'`. The family never re-derives that default by hand.
  - A unique `indexes[]` entry is NOT in the population. It is a different surface, with its own meaning of bare `true` (refused there since protocol 18), and the field-level-versus-`indexes[]` spelling is already an author-time rule (R10).
- **Published sources each expectation is read from.**
  - The scope: `FieldSchema.unique` and `isUniqueDeclared` / `isGlobalUnique`.
  - Its meaning: the `UniqueScopeSchema` docblock and ADR-0120 D1 / D3 / S11.
  - The organization column: `isTenancyDisabled` (ADR-0066).
  - A wall: `postureEnforcesWall` over the stack's `tenancy()` posture.
  - What the caller cannot set: `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` plus `readonly` / `system`.
  - The refusal's identity: `DuplicateRecordError`'s documented split, `DUPLICATE_RECORD` in process and `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` on the wire.
- **Doors.** Each probe writes through one of two doors:
  - **REST** as a signed-in caller: `POST /data/OBJECT`, and `PATCH /data/OBJECT/ID` for the update probe.
  - **The engine's own write as the system principal**: `hooks.run` with `{ system: true }`.
- **Probes.** Per door, `within × insert` and `within × update`; on a walled boot also `across × insert`.
  - A first holder is written and read back.
  - A second record is offered the value **as the first one stores it**, so a normalizing hook (hotcrm upper-cases SKUs) does not hide the collision.
- **Boots and legs.**
  - `within` runs on every boot.
  - `across` runs only on a walled boot (`os verify --multi-tenant`, `bootStack({ multiTenant: true })`). There the family provisions a second organization the way a user makes one: a sign-up that creates its own (`POST /auth/organization/create`).
  - The admin is the first organization's caller when the boot binds it to one; otherwise a second provisioned sign-up is.
  - The system door names the organization on the row (`organization_id`), which is how a system writer must address one under a wall: an org-less system write is refused there with `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` (measured).
  - On a `single` boot, `across` is reported **not run** on `report.boot`, with the reason, never silently skipped.
- **Attribution.** A refusal proves a collision only when two things hold:
  - it is the platform's unique refusal at that door, naming the probed object;
  - it is this field's: it names the field, or it names none and a **twin** (the same record with only the probed value changed) is admitted.
  - The twin exists because of a measured fact. A `true` / `'organization'` constraint is the COALESCE expression index, and SQLite reports it by index name, so the envelope carries no `field` (`uniqueViolationColumn`'s contract). A `'global'` index, or an object with no organization column, names the field.
  - An update needs no twin: it changes nothing else.
  - Any other refusal (an app's own dedupe, a rule, a permission, a constraint on another field) is `unattributed`.
- **Exclusions, with reasons, counted.**
  - A field the caller cannot set (`readonly`, `system`, a runtime-issued `autonumber`) is probed through the **system door only**, which keeps an explicit value (measured: REST answers `droppedFields: readonly` for an autonumber; the system door stores it).
  - A derived value (`formula`, `summary`) is `excluded`.
  - These are `not-derivable`: a closed or tiny value space (`boolean`, `select`, …), a multi-valued reference, a target the app does not declare, an object the CRUD derivation cannot synthesize.
  - A one-to-one reference is probed within; its across leg is named, not run, because the value is one organization's record.
  - An object declaring its own `tenancy.tenantField` has its across leg named, not run.
- **Fixtures.** Reused `deriveCrudCases` / `fillRelationalRefs`. The family-local `fixtureBody` follows slice 2's cut-down shape (required fields, dates spaced, unique values distinct); slice 2's copy is module-private in `delete-behavior.ts`, outside this claim. Fixtures go through the probe's own door and principal, with per-writer base records. Run on a fresh stack of its own.

`os verify --unique-scopes`:
- boots its own fresh stack (with `--multi-tenant`, the walled one);
- adds `uniqueScopes.summary.hardFailures` (contradicted plus failed) to the exit status;
- emits `uniqueScopes` under `--json`.

Without the flag, nothing changes.

## Evidence

All readings at this PR's head unless stated otherwise. The fixture and hotcrm runs used `packages/verify/dist` built from the merged tree `5fae9e5a13`; the only later commit is the two `NOT_A_STAND_IN` rows.

**Fixture app** (`packages/verify/src/unique-scope.test.ts`, `Tests 12 passed (12)`):
- **Single boot:** 9 fields.
  - Probed: 6 per organization, 2 global.
  - 8 proven over 28 writes, all held.
  - 1 not derivable (a unique `boolean`).
  - `across` reported not run.
- **Walled boot** (`multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, real organizations and per-caller stamping, see below): 8 proven over 39 writes, all held. Across, per-organization values are admitted, and a `'global'` value or one with no organization column is refused.

**Negative controls**, one per leg, no engine change:
- **within**: a field declared unique on a table that already holds a duplicate when the declaration arrives.
  - driver-sql cannot create the index and logs that the constraint "is NOT enforced until the data is deduplicated" (ADR-0120 D4).
  - Every second holder is admitted, and the family reports `contradicted` on 4 of 4 writes (REST and system, insert and update), hardFailures 1.
- **across**: a field declared `unique: true` beside a declared `indexes: [{ fields: ['name'], unique: 'global' }]`, the R10 double declaration.
  - The second organization is refused naming the field.
  - The family reports `contradicted` on 2 of 2 across writes, with within held.

**Attribution control:**
- An app hook's own dedupe (`DUPLICATE_VALUE`, the hotcrm shape) is `unattributed` on 4 of 4 writes.
- A field-less unique refusal that the twin meets too (a hook stamps one `code` on every record) is `unattributed` with `twin: refused`.
- Neither is ever credited.

**Ablation of the family's own comparison** (`judge`), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode) inside a scratch script with `trap restore EXIT INT TERM` on absolute paths, at `ed93727ce2`. No build is involved: the test imports the module by a relative path.
- **A.** `if (probe.expected === 'admitted') return { outcome: 'held' };` was replaced by an unconditional `held` plus the marker `ABLATION_15953_S3_A`.
  - On disk: anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `fee9f33f` to `e477ff09`, marker 1 during the run.
  - RED: `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, exactly the within negative control.
  - Restored: blob `fee9f33f` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **B.** The same on `if (probe.expected === 'refused') …` (marker `ABLATION_15953_S3_B`).
  - On disk: anchor 1 to 0, blob `fee9f33f` to `7b2dcfad`, marker 1 during the run.
  - RED: `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, exactly the across negative control.
  - Restored to HEAD's blob, empty diff.
- Predicted direction for both: red. Observed: red.

**hotcrm, the first consumer.** Read-only clone at `1d7148bf`, fetched first. `main` is at `0f84c9c7`, and `git diff 1d7148bf origin/main -- src` adds or removes no `unique` / `autonumber` line (the same grep hits those files at HEAD). The clone's `git status` stayed empty throughout. `os verify` itself cannot boot hotcrm on this tree (protocol `^17.7.0` versus 18), so the family ran directly, as in slices 1-2.
- **Artifact.** Built by hotcrm's own CLI 17.7.0 into the scratchpad.
- **Snapshot.** This tree's `os migrate meta --from 17 --out`, with only `engines.protocol` moved to `^18`.
- **Population.** 13 fields, all per-organization:
  - `crm_account.name`, `crm_contact.email`, `crm_product.sku`;
  - 10 autonumbers, nine of them `'organization'` by the parse default, plus `crm_case.case_number`, which declares `true` by hand.

| run | engine / boot | legs | proven | contradicted | inconclusive | writes held / total |
|---|---|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| A | hotcrm's pinned 17.7.0 `bootStack` over its own artifact, REST door only (17.7.0 has no system door) | within (across not run: hotcrm declares no `@objectstack/organizations`) | 2 | 0 | 11 | 4 / 6 |
| B | this tree, snapshot plus the artifact's 44 hook bodies grafted by name, single | within | 9 | 0 | 4 | 23 / 32 |
| B | the same, walled (`multiTenant: true`, the open `@objectstack/organizations`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`) | within + across | 9 | 0 | 4 | 35 / 48 |
| C | this tree, snapshot with hooks inert, single | within | 11 | 0 | 2 | 28 / 32 |
| C | the same, walled | within + across | 11 | 0 | 2 | 42 / 48 |

**Against what the retired pins asserted (D halves only):**
- **Row 6, `test/account-name-tenant-scope.test.ts`, `crm_account.name`: PROVEN on every run.**
  - "Still rejects a duplicate account name WITHIN one organization": refused through REST and system, insert and update, on the walled boot and on the single boot.
  - "On an UNTENANTED install too": the single boot.
  - "Accepts the same account name in two different organizations": admitted through REST and system on the walled boot.
  - Run A shows the within half holding on hotcrm's own pinned engine.
- **Row 7, `test/case-number-tenant-scope.test.ts`, `crm_case.case_number`: PROVEN on runs B and C.**
  - Within: refused through the system door, insert and update, on both boots.
  - Across: admitted in a second organization on the walled boot.
  - It is an autonumber, so REST is excluded (that door drops the value), and Run A, which is REST only, names it inconclusive with that reason.
- 0 contradictions with what either file asserted.

**Extra evidence, not a table row: `test/contact-email-tenant-scope.test.ts`.** This file's subject is hotcrm's `contact_integrity` hook (an app dedupe, a K property), with the `(organization, email)` index behind it.
- Hooks live: within is `unattributed`, because the hook answers its own `DUPLICATE_VALUE` (the attribution control holding on a real app). On the single boot the system insert reaches the index and is credited: the hook scopes a system write by the row's own organization stamp, and that write carries none. Across, the value is admitted through both doors ("lets ANOTHER organization know the same person").
- Hooks inert: proven.

**Inconclusive on hotcrm, with the app's own reasons:**
- `crm_campaign_member.member_number` and `crm_event_attendee.attendee_number`: a generic fixture names no lead or contact party.
- `crm_contract.contract_number`: `contract_validation` ties the term to the dates (hooks live only).
- `crm_contact.email`: as above.

## Verification

At head `9c89d3cc89`: this branch with `origin/main` `0cbfb7c32c` merged, so 9 files and 1637 changed lines (`+1630 / -7`) against merge base `0cbfb7c32`. Readings below are at that head unless another commit is named.

**Suites.**
- **`@objectstack/verify`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` reads `Test Files 34 passed (34)` / `Tests 270 passed (270)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`. The family file alone reads `Tests 12 passed (12)`.
- **Typechecks:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck: OK` holds for both (at `5fae9e5a13`; no file of either program changed since). `tsc --listFilesOnly -p tsconfig.test.json` shows `unique-scope.test.ts` in verify's program (2 hits, with its module) and `verify-unique-scopes.test.ts` in the CLI's (1 hit; control `verify-delete-behaviors.test.ts`, 1 hit).
- **CLI unit tier:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` reads `Test Files 283 passed (283)` / `Tests 4270 passed (4270)` (at `5fae9e5a13`; the second merge changed no `packages/cli` file).
- **CLI integration tier:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2` over the six `verify-*` files, this PR's new one included, reads `Test Files 6 passed (6)` / `Tests 18 passed (18)`. The rest of the integration tier is declared to CI.
- **Core `repo` project:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2` reads `Test Files 6 passed (6)` / `Tests 83 passed (83)`. The `#22661` second-object read pin is among them, green with no `CALLERS` row.
- **`pnpm check:verify-stand-in`:**
  - Before the rows: exit 1, `2 problem(s)` (`runUniqueScopeProofs` and `formatUniqueScopeReport` unclassified).
  - After: exit 0, `OK check-verify-stand-in-erasure: 2 stand-in check(s) guarded, 13 candidate(s) explicitly exempt, 10 call site(s) reached, 0 asserted driver arguments`.
  - `--self-test` OK.

**Gates.**
- **Derivation:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, gives 115 commands (64 `pnpm`, 51 direct `node`).
- **Results:** every one exits 0, with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reads `Run reconciliation — 115 derived, 115 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`
  - The derivation was current when the run began.
  - The reconcile pass printed `STALE TREE`, because `origin/main` moved 4 commits during the 40-minute run (to `e448d3c27f`). The stale family files are `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, none on this PR's paths.
  - An earlier battery at `5e776ba287` recorded 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:i18n-coverage`, each needing packages outside the built closures). After a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (73 tasks), this battery measured all three, exit 0.
  - Every command and its printed verdict line is in the report comment on #15953.

**Lint, by proven narrowing** at `9c89d3cc89`: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 touched source files.
1. **Population, read from eslint's own config:** `--print-config` resolves for 6 of 6.
2. **Counts, read from the JSON:** 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
3. **Invariance:** `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules, its own comment at `:327-328`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

The two `.md` / `.mdx` files are outside eslint's population.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed (none is a reproducible defect through a public door, a contract violation or an authoring trap; carrier: none):

- `bootStack` over an UNPARSED object literal registers the raw field. An `autonumber` that authors no `unique` therefore gets no index there, and a system-door duplicate is admitted (measured: raw literal 2 of 2 admitted; the same object through `defineStack` stores `'organization'` and refuses the second).
  - Every config `os verify` / `os validate` / `os build` load is `defineStack`-built (`STACK_PROVENANCE_MISSING` otherwise), so no public door reaches it.
  - The family reads the parse's scope and would report such a programmatic boot contradicted.
  - This PR's positive fixture boots `defineStack` output for that reason.
- The ADR-0120 D3 NULL-organization bucket is unreachable through either door on today's runtime: a `single` install derives its one organization for a system write, and REST stamps the caller's. So "untenanted install" is the single-posture boot, plus objects with no organization column. The NULL-row DDL fact stays row 7's R residue (driver-sql).
- `os verify --multi-tenant` with the open `@objectstack/organizations` refuses to boot until a membership policy is declared (`WalledMembershipPolicyError`; `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`). This is by that package's design, and it applies to `--rls --multi-tenant` alike. The README states it beside the flag.
- The CLI-level control in `packages/cli/test/verify-unique-scopes.test.ts` is a door that faults on a duplicate (exit 1), not a contradiction. Through `os verify`, every config is `defineStack`-built on a fresh database, so no metadata makes a same-organization duplicate land. The across leg needs `--multi-tenant`, whose runtime package no framework package may declare, so CI's test graph cannot boot it. The two contradiction controls are in `packages/verify`.
- The walled-boot unit suites use `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`: a walled posture with real organizations (`/auth/organization/create`) and per-caller stamping, measured. The family's subject is which rows collide, which the index decides from each row's organization; read isolation is not under test. The real-package walled boot is exercised by the hotcrm runs above.

## Deviations

- PM mechanism assumption 2 was measured and partly falsified. The per-organization refusal carries no `field` (SQLite names the expression index), so "proved only on that code naming the probed field" would prove no per-organization field at all. Attribution therefore also accepts a field-less unique refusal when the twin is admitted, and pins it with the attribution control above.
- The conditional `NOT_A_STAND_IN` surface was used (2 rows), because `check:verify-stand-in` asked. The `#22661` pin needed no `CALLERS` row: the family reads a reference's target from the CRUD derivation and never calls `referenceTargetOf` (the `repo` project is green without one).
- `origin/main` (`df7a137923`, 4 commits, none on this surface) was merged before the PR, per AGENTS.md section 10. The build was refreshed, and every suite and gate here was run on the merged tree.
- Commits carry the model-free trailer pair per AGENTS.md, and this body ends with its session-URL footer rather than the harness's own attribution form.
